note: Found by reading the rendered panel in a browser rather than the source: the V16 preview inside the DTD Jackpot panel still said eligibility needs 3 SbPoW blocks in the last 5,000. The V16.1 window is 2,016 - the 5,000 figure was the V16.0 draft. Corrected, and the panel now also states that the first draw at #30,186 requires 0/0 heartbeats, ramping to 3-of-4 from #31,338. Jackpot archive reachable from everywhere it is asked for, and the cooldown card that did not belong in a jackpot panel is gone. The DTD Jackpot panel had a card titled NORMAL DTD RECENT-MINER COOLDOWN - a normal-DTD rule, in the panel of a draw that has no cooldown at all, which is the clearest way to teach somebody the wrong thing. That slot is now JACKPOT ARCHIVE: the number of jackpots paid, click to open the full winners table. The cooldown itself is not lost - it is explained in the eligibility section, stated as normal DTD only, with the same expandable identity list. The JACKPOTS PAID card is clickable and opens the same archive. The View all jackpots button no longer requires the last winner to have loaded first (replay needs it, the archive reconstructs from chain and does not), so the archive is always reachable. The winner overlay that appears on a live or replayed jackpot got the same button, because that is where people ask about previous draws. All five entry points call one function, SJP.openArchive, over one data source. Banner and explorer corrected against what is actually published. (1) The operational notice still said the final binaries, hashes and operator guide WOULD be published before the window - they are published: tag v16.2.3, three binaries and SHA256SUMS, downloaded back and verified. It now states the release is available and links it. (2) The upgrade guide moved to a version-neutral URL, sost-upgrade.html, with the old sost-upgrade-v1622.html left as a redirect so no existing link breaks. (3) The 0/0 heartbeat requirement for the FIRST draw at #30,186 is now stated next to the four Jackpot requirements, not sixty lines below them, so nobody concludes they cannot enter for lack of heartbeat history. (4) The explorer DTD card said permanent 1-of-3; since V15 (#25,000) the draw happens on EVERY block - 3-of-3 - and the subtitle now computes all three eras. (5) Atomic swap: the console said the feature was activating at block 16,000 (long passed) and the DEX status legend said BTC lands with V15 (V15 passed and BTC is still OFF); both now state that the SOST-side gates are live, the EVM contract is undeployed and unaudited, and the Bitcoin leg is OFF in the official binaries. (6) Gold terminology removed from the metadata of thirteen pages: gold backed crypto, gold backed coin, constitutional gold. The update window is unchanged: node AND miner, after #29,900 and before #30,000, with consensus activating by itself at #30,000.
